## Updates
- The Latest update channel now downloads updates in the background and installs them silently once your Mac is idle and nothing is recording, instead of waiting for you to click Install.

## Floating Pill
- On multi-display setups, the floating pill now reliably appears on the correct screen when one of WhisperShortcut's own windows (Chat, Settings, a report, onboarding) is focused, instead of sometimes lighting up on the wrong monitor.

## Installation
Download the DMG from the [releases page](https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/releases), open it, and drag WhisperShortcut to your Applications folder.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/compare/v9.09...v9.10
